signal: ScaleOps raised $130M Series C at an $800M+ valuation and launched AI Infrastructure Resource Management (2025-2026)

email.body1:
Zak, saw ScaleOps closed its $130M Series C and launched AI Infrastructure Resource Management.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play across the Americas than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for ScaleOps off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zak, quick follow-up for ScaleOps.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ScaleOps needs to close that gap in the Americas this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zak, last bit of proof for ScaleOps.

Memgraph, also infra, had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how ScaleOps' reply rate likely compares to other Series-C infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zak, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-C infra motion? I'll tailor it to ScaleOps either way.
